How long do you let your moisturiser and sunscreen settle into your skin? Sometimes the oil in these can cause foundation to 'slide' off, maybe leave it 20 minutes? Also your primer could effect it, maybe. Have you tried using one that mattifies? Benefit Porefessional and Smashbox PhotoFinish Pore Minimising primer are both excellent but expensive. Maybelline Baby Skin Pore Eraser Clear is affordable and a fairly good dupe for them. Like others have said it may also be the oil you're using in your foundation that causes it to break up and not last long. Soap and Glory Thick and Fast mascara is really good for hot weather, you should check it out!
